findings.explanation: Co che dedup ben vung (runtimeStorage.tryMarkMid, dua tren khoa mid, luu trong Postgres/file - khong het han, xem core/storage/postgres-adapter.js:1114) CHI chay khi event co event.message.mid (dong 649, 657: if (mid) {...}). Cac su kien postback (nut bam menu/CTA) lay userText tu event.postback?.payload (dong 751) va KHONG BAO GIO co message.mid theo cau truc Messenger Platform, nen doan guard 'if (mid)' bi bo qua hoan toan cho toan bo luong postback - dung dung y comment o dong 656 'Dedup theo message id (Meta co the retry)'. Lop bao ve duy nhat con lai cho postback la shouldSkipDuplicateMessageText (dong 764), voi TTL chi 5 giay (MESSAGE_TEXT_DEDUPE_TTL_MS, dong 26) va luu trong Map in-memory (recentMessageTextKeys, dong 85) - mat khi restart/deploy va khong dung chung giua nhieu instance khi scale ngang. Meta co the retry webhook lau hon 5 giay (backoff nhieu phut/gio khi khong nhan 200 kip thoi), nen mot postback bi retry sau >5s hoac roi vao instance khac se duoc xu ly lai tu dau va gui lai tin nhan/menu cho khach lan 2 - dung kich ban su co da xay ra trong production. tests/webhook.test.js khong co test nao cho postback events, xac nhan khoang trong nay chua duoc kiem thu.
